lines.text: دارند و اعتقاد دیگر خط ستارگان نزد ربیع نزد خط ستارگان ماده در برج ماده
lines.en: They have another belief regarding the line of the stars near spring, near the line of the female stars in the female sign.

lines.text: دیگر خط ستارگان در روز فوق الارض و ستارگان ماده در شب تحت الارض و جمله خطها
lines.en: Another is the line of the stars in the day above the earth, and the female stars in the night below the earth, and all the lines

lines.text: بر این قیاس باید کردن باب شانزدهم در بیان اوجات و جوزهرات بدانکه اوج
lines.en: must be made on this analogy. Chapter sixteen: On the explanation of apogees and nodes. Know that the apogee

lines.text: جایی باشد از فلک که چون ستاره بدان جایگاه رسد غایت بلندی وی باشد
lines.en: is a place in the sphere that when a star reaches that place, it is its extreme height

lines.text: از زمین و برابر آن حضیض خوانند و آن کوتاه ترین جایی باشد از فلک که چون
lines.en: from the earth, and opposite it they call the perigee, and that is the lowest place in the sphere that when

lines.text: ستاره بدان جایگاه رسد غایت بلندی وی باشد از زمین و غایت قوّه کواکب
lines.en: a star reaches that place, it is its extreme height from the earth, and the extreme strength of the stars

lines.text: در اوج باشد و غایت ضعف او در حضیض باشد و هر که که ستاره در نیمه اوّل باشد
lines.en: is in the apogee, and its extreme weakness is in the perigee, and whenever a star is in the first half

lines.text: اندر فلک اوج صاعد باشد و اوج در یکموضع ثابت نیست و در ده سال نه دقیقه
lines.en: in the sphere of the apogee, it is ascending, and the apogee is not fixed in one place, and in ten years it is nine minutes.

lines.text: حرکت دارد و اوج بحقیقت از زیج توان دانست و صورت اوج و حضیض اینست
lines.en: It has motion, and the apogee in truth can be known from the astronomical tables, and the form of the apogee and perigee is this.

lines.text: امّا جوزهرات انجایگاهست که فلک ستاره و فلک شمس برهم افتد انرا جوزهرات خوانند
lines.en: But the nodes are that place where the sphere of the star and the sphere of the sun intersect; they call that the nodes.

lines.text: و برابر وی ذنب خوانند و هر که که ستاره از جوزهر بذنب میشود عرضش شمالی بود
lines.en: And opposite to it they call the tail (descending node), and whenever a star goes from the node to the tail, its latitude is northern.

lines.text: و هر که که از ذنب بجوزهر میشود جنوبی و هر که که میان جوزهر ذنب باشد غایت
lines.en: And whenever it goes from the tail to the node, it is southern, and whenever it is between the node and the tail, it is the utmost

summary.headline: Apogees, Perigees, and Nodes
summary.text: Chapter sixteen explains apogees, perigees, and nodes: the apogee is a star’s greatest height and strength, the perigee its lowest position and weakness, and the apogee’s motion is determined from astronomical tables. It also defines the nodes as intersections of a star’s sphere with the Sun’s sphere and relates movement between the node and descending node to northern or southern latitude.
